From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps + proposal for rotating demo windows (GlobeTek)

Hi Sara / Aaron —

Great to meet you both today — thanks for walking through the GlobeTek use case and the integrations roadmap. Quick recap and a single ask to keep momentum:

Recap (high level)
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for multi-region customer flows and get predictable unit economics for batch re-ranks.
- Must-haves: VPC isolation, audit logs retention >= 12 months, SSO + KMS integration.
- Timeline: pilot in Q3, production by end of Q4 if the pilot metrics look good.

Ask: schedule the technical deep-dive/demo (45–60m) with your infra and platform folks. Because the team spans US/EU/APAC, I sketched a rotating schedule to share the load while keeping consistent weekday windows. Below are 3 concrete options — pick the column that best matches your core team each week and we'll rotate weeks after the pilot kickoff.

Proposed rotating windows (all times shown with local conversions)
- Option A (US-first week):
  • Week 1: Tue 09:00–10:00 PT / 12:00–13:00 ET / 17:00–18:00 BST (UK) / 21:00–22:00 AEDT (Sydney)
  • Week 2: Wed 08:00–09:00 PT / 11:00–12:00 ET / 16:00–17:00 BST / 20:00–21:00 AEDT
  • Week 3: Thu 17:00–18:00 BST / 09:00–10:00 PT (early) / 21:00–22:00 AEDT
- Option B (EU-first week):
  • Week 1: Wed 16:00–17:00 BST / 08:00–09:00 PT / 11:00–12:00 ET / 00:00–01:00 AEST
  • Week 2: Thu 09:00–10:00 ET / 06:00–07:00 PT / 15:00–16:00 BST
- Option C (APAC-first week):
  • Week 1: Mon 20:00–21:00 AEST / 03:00–04:00 BST (same day) / 22:00–23:00 PT (prev day)

Notes:
- Each session is ~45–60 mins: first 20–30 mins demo + 15–30 mins focused infra questions (networking, KMS, dataflow).
- We'll record and keep a short tech summary in the drive link below so teams that miss one week can quickly catch up.

Attachments: discovery notes (summary) and a small visual showing the rotation patterns.

If you tell me which Option (A/B/C) and which of the three weekly slots works best for the core tech reviewers, I’ll lock in a rotating invite and include the Zoom link and pre-reads.

Thanks —
Chloe Martin
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Thanks Chloe — really helpful summary. Aaron and I reviewed this with the infra lead (will loop them into the next thread once we confirm a slot). High-level preference is Option B (EU-first), because our core infra and SRE folks are in London and it's much easier for them to join consistently.

Preferred concrete times (ranked):
1) Thu 09:00–10:00 ET / 06:00–07:00 PT / 15:00–16:00 BST (this maps to your Option B, Week 2)
2) Wed 16:00–17:00 BST / 08:00–09:00 PT (Option B, Week 1) — acceptable on rotation weeks

We also want the pilot kickoff session to have a short agenda item on compliance (audit log retention + data residency). Aaron will share the list of compliance reviewers.

Can you send a rotating invite (recurring, weekly, but with a 3-week rotation tag in the title) and we’ll confirm the attendee list from our side?

—Sara
